name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And White Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Expertly crafted from a premium 2-layer construction, combining 5mm wood and 3mm white acrylic to create a durable, elegant, and long-lasting personalized milestone sign.
    - Every component is carefully laser cut with smooth, polished edges to ensure a premium appearance and safe handling.
    - Includes a sturdy wooden display stand, allowing the sign to stand securely on any flat surface.
    - Designed for repeated use year after year by simply updating the writable sections.
    - Optional Liquid Chalk Marker Set (8 colors) is available for purchase separately to complete your milestone board.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in two popular sizes:
             +) 8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
             +) 10 × 10 inches ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Wooden board: Printed on both sides with vivid, fade-resistant artwork.
    - White acrylic layer: Supports 1-sided printing or can be left blank depending on your chosen option.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a reusable personalized display sign for recording milestones, special moments, or important information.
    - Features interchangeable white acrylic pieces that can be easily written on and updated using a liquid chalk marker.
    - Simply wipe clean after use for repeated use on different occasions.
    - Includes a sturdy wooden stand for quick assembly and stable tabletop display.
    - Ideal for milestone photos, celebrations, classrooms, parties, home décor, offices, nurseries, or special event displays.
    - A versatile keepsake that can be personalized for different themes, occasions, and memories throughout the year.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for children, students, parents, grandparents, teachers, friends, coworkers, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Birthdays, Baby Showers, Back to School, First Day of School, Last Day of School, Graduation, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Housewarmings, Anniversaries, Family Celebrations, and many other special occasions.
    - Personalized with names, messages, or milestone details to create a unique and meaningful keepsake.
    - Makes a beautiful photo prop and decorative display that can be treasured for years.
    - Adds a personal touch to homes, classrooms, offices, nurseries, or party decorations. 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And White Acrylic Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
